# Dreweb — Digital Agency & Software Engineering

> Premium Web Design, Full-Stack SaaS Engineering, UI/UX Design, and AI Automation Agency.

## Overview
Dreweb (https://dreweb.online) is a full-service digital agency and software engineering consultancy. We specialize in building high-converting websites, scalable custom web applications, SaaS platforms, and enterprise AI workflow automation.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Web & App Development**: Custom websites, SaaS applications, e-commerce stores, and high-performance React/Node.js/PostgreSQL platforms.
- **UI/UX Design & Prototyping**: Modern, conversion-focused design systems with fluid micro-interactions, bento grid layouts, and mobile-first architecture.
- **AI Automation & Agents**: Custom AI agent workflows, CRM integrations, and intelligent automation systems to eliminate repetitive operations.
- **SEO & Growth Optimization**: Technical SEO, structured data markup, performance engineering, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- **Brand Identity**: Logo design, typography systems, and cohesive digital design languages.
